content.json:
## Power Scheduler — summary (large tenants)
Totals and trends built from the **one summary record per cycle** (`pwrsched.summary`), so the cost and speed of these queries don't grow with the number of resources. For per-resource detail, use the day-2 operations workbook. Open this workbook from the scheduler's Application Insights resource.

Day labels are Bangkok time; chart time axes follow your browser's time zone.

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions["pwrsched.event"] == "pwrsched.summary"
| extend started = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.started"]),
         stopped = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.stopped"]),
         skipped = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.skipped"]),
         failed = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.failed"]),
         evaluated = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.evaluated"]),
         dur = todouble(customDimensions["pwrsched.durationSeconds"]),
         cap = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.capReached"]))
| summarize Cycles = count(),
            Started = sum(started),
            Stopped = sum(stopped),
            Failed = sum(failed),
            ['Cycles at cap'] = countif(cap == "true"),
            ['Avg resources evaluated'] = round(avg(evaluated), 0),
            ['Avg duration (s)'] = round(avg(dur), 1),
            ['Max duration (s)'] = round(max(dur), 1)
content.title: Totals for the selected period
content.noDataMessage: No cycle summaries in this time range.

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions["pwrsched.event"] == "pwrsched.summary"
| extend started = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.started"]),
         stopped = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.stopped"]),
         skipped = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.skipped"]),
         failed = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.failed"]),
         evaluated = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.evaluated"]),
         dur = todouble(customDimensions["pwrsched.durationSeconds"]),
         cap = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.capReached"]))
| summarize Started = sum(started), Stopped = sum(stopped), Failed = sum(failed) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Starts, stops and failures per hour

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions["pwrsched.event"] == "pwrsched.summary"
| extend started = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.started"]),
         stopped = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.stopped"]),
         skipped = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.skipped"]),
         failed = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.failed"]),
         evaluated = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.evaluated"]),
         dur = todouble(customDimensions["pwrsched.durationSeconds"]),
         cap = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.capReached"]))
// Day as Bangkok-time text, so the grid doesn't convert it again.
| extend Day = format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "Asia/Bangkok"), "yyyy-MM-dd")
| summarize Cycles = count(),
            Started = sum(started),
            Stopped = sum(stopped),
            Failed = sum(failed),
            ['Cycles at cap'] = countif(cap == "true"),
            ['Max duration (s)'] = round(max(dur), 1)
          by ['Day (Bangkok)'] = Day
| order by ['Day (Bangkok)'] desc
content.title: Per day (Bangkok)

content.json: **Cycle duration.** One cycle must finish within the function timeout (`functionTimeout` in `src/host.json`) and before the next cycle (NFR-002). Rising maximums are an early warning to apply the scaling backlog (REQUIREMENTS §10.1).

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions["pwrsched.event"] == "pwrsched.summary"
| extend started = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.started"]),
         stopped = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.stopped"]),
         skipped = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.skipped"]),
         failed = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.failed"]),
         evaluated = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.evaluated"]),
         dur = todouble(customDimensions["pwrsched.durationSeconds"]),
         cap = tolower(tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.capReached"]))
| summarize ['Max duration (s)'] = max(dur), ['Avg duration (s)'] = avg(dur) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Cycle duration per hour (seconds)

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions["pwrsched.event"] == "pwrsched.capReached"
| order by timestamp desc
| project ['Time (Bangkok)'] = format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "Asia/Bangkok"), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
          Cap = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.cap"]),
          Deferred = toint(customDimensions["pwrsched.deferred"]),
          RunId = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.runId"])
content.title: Cycles that hit the action cap
content.noDataMessage: The action cap was not reached in this time range.

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions["pwrsched.event"] == "pwrsched.decision"
| extend result = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.result"])
| where result == "failed" or result startswith "skipped"
| summarize Count = count(),
            Resources = dcount(tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.resourceId"]))
          by Result = result, Type = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.type"])
| order by Count desc
content.title: Failed or skipped, by result and resource type
content.noDataMessage: No failed or skipped decisions in this time range.
